task: 512-d face embedding (EdgeFace, EdgeNeXt XXS backbone). Not a detection/classification model - see uniface-adaface-recognition/manifest.json for the full explanation of why this manifest's shape differs from the intern-* manifests and what an embedding manifest can honestly claim.
note:
Real gate-2 shape independently re-confirmed this session: input 'input' (batch,3,112,112) float32, output NAMED 'embedding' (batch,512) float32 - note the output tensor's own name differs from adaface/mobileface/sphereface's 'output' (all confirmed live via onnxruntime.InferenceSession against the real artifacts, not assumed uniform across the family). The decode reads the output by position (session.run(None, ...)[0]) rather than by this specific name, since all four embedding models have exactly one output tensor regardless of its name - matched against the real artifact's actual output count, not a name-based shortcut.

Same fixture, same detector, same honesty caveats as uniface-adaface-recognition/manifest.json: only stock_streetscene_3adults.jpg has usable real faces anywhere in this repo's fixtures, the production SCRFD detector found 2 of the 3 visible faces, and there is no same-identity pair anywhere in this project's fixtures to test true recognition recall against - that gap is stated here, not padded over.

EdgeFace's own preprocessing does not override BaseRecognizer.preprocess (confirmed against the real uniface/recognition/edgeface.py source, which defines no preprocess() override) - so, unlike AdaFace, it takes the base class's RGB-converting, (pixel-127.5)/127.5 path. Its raw output on these two real faces is NOT unit-norm (3.48 / 3.70) - genuinely different from AdaFace's exactly-1.0 raw norm on the same two faces, a real per-checkpoint fact, not assumed uniform across the embedding family.

expected.non_degenerate: the two faces' embeddings must not be identical or all-zero
expected.different_identity_cosine_similarity_low: expected roughly near 0 (weak signal only, see uniface-adaface-recognition/manifest.json) for these two different real people

images.note: Same 2 real faces, same alignment, same detector as uniface-adaface-recognition.
